task_completion.description: The System Advisor Model (SAM) application is launched and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SAM application window is open on the desktop.

task_completion.description: A 10 kW DC system with a 30-degree tilt and south-facing (180 deg) azimuth is configured.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' page in SAM shows 'Nameplate capacity' as 10 kW, 'Tilt' as 30, and 'Azimuth' as 180.

task_completion.description: Weather data for Phoenix, Tucson, and Des Moines is selected/downloaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Location and Resource' page shows the selection or search for Phoenix, AZ; Tucson, AZ; and Des Moines, IA.

task_completion.description: Simulations are run for all three specified locations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Results' page or a summary table shows data being generated for each of the three cities.

task_completion.description: A JSON file is created at the specified path containing the comparison data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or text editor shows a file at /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/PV_Location_Comparison.json containing city names, annual energy values, and the best/worst identification.

integrity.description: The agent used the SAM graphical user interface rather than just command line scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with SAM menus, buttons, and input fields.

integrity.description: The agent actually ran the simulation rather than hardcoding known values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Simulate' button is clicked and a progress bar or 'Results' dashboard appears with calculated values.

integrity.description: The agent maintained identical system parameters across all three location runs.
integrity.visual_evidence: The system design inputs (10kW, 30 tilt) remain unchanged when switching between weather files.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For a 10kW fixed system at 30-degree tilt: Phoenix, AZ will have the highest annual energy production (approx 17,000-19,000 kWh). Tucson, AZ will be very close to Phoenix but usually slightly lower. Des Moines, IA will have the lowest production (approx 13,000-14,000 kWh). The JSON must be saved at /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/PV_Location_Comparison.json.
